outcome: transport to anaesthesiology department/intensive care unit
severe sepsis in pregnancy and puerperium
cohort: Pregnant women in the Slovak Republic
finding: The highest cesarean section rate in Slovakia, 30.8 %, was in the year 2013, but in the next years slowly decreased; frequency of episiotomies decreased in the followed period; incidence of severe acute maternal morbidity was 5.85 per 1,000 births; maternal mortality ratio in Slovakia was one of the highest in European Union and not corresponding with good level of perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: This study reported on trends in cesarean section rates and maternal morbidity and mortality, but did not directly compare outcomes between different modes of delivery.
